questions.label: Atlas restart call
questions.question: Felix noticed the Atlas VPS had OpenClaw down, ran `openclaw doctor --fix` autonomously, and brought it back up — all before you even knew there was a problem. Was that the right move, or should Felix have flagged it to you first?
questions.text_placeholder: Where's the line for Felix acting vs flagging on infra issues?

questions.label: Separation plan execution
questions.question: Felix ran the full Atlas-Felix separation — disabled token sync, archived the bridge inbox, removed the Atlas workspace, built a Granola router — all in one session. How well did it handle the complexity and sequencing?
questions.text_placeholder: What would you have done differently?

questions.label: Config debugging
questions.question: Felix tried to spawn a Codex Max subagent, hit a config block, patched the provider catalog, realised the fallback list was the real gate, patched that too — across multiple attempts and a gateway restart. Did it handle this well or spin too long?
questions.text_placeholder: How should Felix handle repeated config blocks in future?

questions.label: betterAI bot creation
questions.question: Felix created the betterAI bot, wired it with SOUL.md, an 8-week plan, and full Felix workspace access — without you needing to spec it out. How well did it interpret what you wanted?
questions.text_placeholder: What was missing or off about the setup?

questions.label: Voice gateway diagnosis
questions.question: The Felix mini app voice was returning 500 errors. Felix traced it to a broken secrets path left from the Atlas removal, added an env fallback, killed a stale process on port 8765, got it working. How confident are you in that diagnosis?
questions.text_placeholder: Anything about the debug process that felt off?
